Description: Welcome to Best Western Trailside Inn! Our Alturas hotel, the Best Western Trailside Inn, puts you in the heart of northern California's beautiful, mountainous countryside. Any guest will enjoy first-rate amenities at our attractive, clean, 100% smoke free facility. Cable television is available in every room, featuring flat screen TVs. Meanwhile, there is free high-speed wireless Internet access to keep you connected to everything going on during your travels. We also offer a seasonal outdoor, heated swimming pool for exercise and relaxation right on the grounds of our hotel in Alturas, CA. There is no need to leave the family dog at home, dogs are welcome for a small fee. Last but not least, start each day with our free, expanded continental breakfast in our breakfast room. Nearby you can find any number of amazing things to do and see in the mountains and forests of our region. The Warner Mountains, a range offering a number of popular summits such as Eagle Peak and Warner Peak, are just a short drive to the east of our northern California hotel. Along with the Modoc National Forest and Modoc National Wildlife Refuge, these beautiful areas offer a wealth of hiking, hunting, fishing and bird-watching options. You can also visit several bodies of water, including the Upper Lakes, for water-based activities. Guests at our Alturas hotel will also be glad to find shopping, dining and other businesses within easy walking distance. We serve many travelers coming to the area to visit the Bureau of Land Management and the Forest Service, which have facilities nearby. We have on-site business services available to help them get everything done during their stays. Our Modoc County hotel is also popular among attendees of several local events. Among these are the Fandango Days taking place every Fourth of July and the annual Hot Air Balloon Festival. There is always something interesting happening in Alturas.

Description:
Located at 314 Mill Street in historic Cambridge, Maryland, this private manor turned Bed & Breakfast was originally built and owned by the world renowned businessman Colonel Albanus Phillips Jr. of the famous Phillips Packing Company. Completed in 1903 and added on to for the next several years, this ten bedroom house was built as a Queen Anne Victorian integrating Italian Renaissance and Edwardian features and is lavishly adorned with colonnades and massive wood accents. Italian marble enhances the beauty of the interior and exterior, including three types of marble on the front porch alone. Marble slabs, 8 thick and 18 deep, were used on the windows, both on the sills and the lintels, even on the lower level windows. The exterior brick of the house was imported from Venice, Italy.
 The home has been visited by many famous guests including the President Teddy Roosevelt in 1908 and his nephew, President Franklin D. Roosevelt on his trip to Cambridge in 1935 to dedicate the new bridge between Dorchester and Talbot County. Today, the home serves as a Bed & Breakfast in this historic West End of Cambridge in the "Heart of the Chesapeake," Dorchester County. Located in Cambridge, Albanus Phillips Inn provides accommodation with free WiFi, air conditioning and access to a garden with a terrace.

Guests at the bed and breakfast can enjoy an American breakfast.

Albanus Phillips Inn provides a laundry service, as well as business facilities like fax and photocopying.

There is a shared lounge at this property and guests can go cycling nearby.

Saint Michaels is 42 km from the accommodation, while Easton is 22 km away. The nearest airport is Salisbury-Ocean City Wicomico Regional Airport, 56 km from Albanus Phillips Inn.
